notes.title: Uncover the World of Ink Link - Demo is out!
notes.content:
🚀 It's Here: The Ink Link Demo is LIVE! 🚀

Hey friends!

The wait is finally over — the Ink Link demo is out now!
I can't wait for you to dive in, explore, and have a blast with it!

If you enjoy the experience (or even if you're just curious), please consider adding Ink Link to your wishlist — it helps a ton and truly means the world to me. ❤️

Thank you all so much for the love and support. More exciting updates are just around the corner — stay tuned!

Take care and happy playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349935/abc37922c049de8fbea6f487c19bed0a2140c6ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Ink Link Demo Dropping Soon! ✨💥
notes.content:
🚀 Ink Link Demo is Almost Here! 🚀

Hey everyone!

I'm thrilled to announce that the demo for Ink Link is almost ready for you to try! 🎉

Over the past few months, I’ve been hard at work fixing tons of bugs (seriously, there were so many 😅), and I’m happy to say the game is now stable and polished for you to enjoy.

If you haven’t already, add Ink Link to your wishlist—it really helps a lot and means the world to me! ❤️

Stay tuned, and I can't wait for you to play!

—Take care!
